Sandbox_KFM_Enabled_tooltip: Turns Field Medicine procedures and additional illness effects on or off. Disabling releases this mod's tourniquet support and restores untreated bleeding.
Sandbox_KFM_ExamEnabled_tooltip: Allows the clinical exam from the health panel and from a stethoscope / tongue depressor.
Sandbox_KFM_ShowFeverInExam_tooltip: The exam reports fever without its cause (any fever looks the same). Hardcore servers can hide it.
Sandbox_KFM_SkillRequirementOffset_toolt: Added to the level needed by tourniquet, cauterization, fracture reduction and debridement (exam and irrigation always level 0). Default 0.
Sandbox_KFM_ProcedurePainMultiplier_tool: Pain added by the procedures. Default 1.
Sandbox_KFM_IrrigationStrength_tooltip: How much wound infection one irrigation removes. Default 1.
Sandbox_KFM_TourniquetSafeHours_tooltip: In-game hours before the limb starts losing health and hurting. Lasting damage after 3x this time. Default 2.
Sandbox_KFM_FractureReductionMax_tooltip: Cap of the healing time removed by a successful fracture reduction (0.40 = 40%). Default 0.40.
Sandbox_KFM_XPMultiplier_tooltip: XP given by the procedures (only on real injuries, with a cooldown per patient). Default 1.
Sandbox_KFM_IllnessEnabled_tooltip: Common illness and injury episodes. Server authoritative; progression pauses offline. Severe complications give warnings before gradual damage.
Sandbox_KFM_ContactTransmissionEnabled_t: Viral contact spread. Server authoritative; progression pauses offline. Severe complications give warnings before gradual damage.
Sandbox_KFM_NewDiseaseMortalityEnabled_t: Neglected severe complications can kill. Server authoritative; progression pauses offline. Severe complications give warnings before gradual damage.
Sandbox_KFM_DiseaseFrequency_tooltip: Exposure risk multiplier. Server authoritative; progression pauses offline. Severe complications give warnings before gradual damage.
Sandbox_KFM_DiseaseSeverity_tooltip: Symptom severity multiplier. Server authoritative; progression pauses offline. Severe complications give warnings before gradual damage.
Sandbox_KFM_SeasonalIllnessEnabled_toolt: Seasonal cold and wet-heat illness. Server controlled; no offline catch-up or native trait-point changes.
Sandbox_KFM_MosquitoIllnessEnabled_toolt: Summer mosquito-associated illness. Server controlled; no offline catch-up or native trait-point changes.
